quest.title: Plant Research: Twinleaf Pitcher Plants
quest.description: A large patch of Twinleaf Pitcher Plants has suddenly appeared somewhere on Lempo Isle...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Linnea quickly makes the necessary preparations for the investigation...

talks.objective: Head to the designated location to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: Excuse me, have you seen a tiger-striped cat around here by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: A tiger-striped cat? Hmm, I don't think so... Lumi, did you notice one?

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-ho?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Looks like Lumi hasn't seen it either. Did your cat go missing? I can help you look for it! I know this area pretty well.

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Hey, Jukka! We don't have the spare money to hire an adventurer. And besides, it's just a silly cat. Let it end up wherever it wants!

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: Don't say that, Marja. It'd be sad if it heard you.

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: As if it could hear us! If it could, it would've come to us by now — we've been shouting for ages.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: No need to pay me a commission for that. I was going to check out the area anyway, so I'll keep an eye out while I'm at it. Let's go, Lumi!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (There was nothing here not long ago, and now there are so many Twinleaf Pitcher Plants growing.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Maybe some animal brought the seeds here, but I can't just let them spread like this...)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Lumi, do you think it's here too?

dialogues.speaker: Lumi
dialogues.text: Ya-hoho!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The trapped cat is rescued...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: So you're the one they've been looking for, huh? Hmm... doesn't look like you've got any injuries. But if we'd found you any later... who knows what could've happened.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's get you back to your friends first!

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Silly cat... where on earth are you— Oh! You found it!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It got trapped in those Twinleaf Pitcher Plants over there. They're plants, yes, but they're carnivorous, and can digest Moonglow Fireflies in just a few days...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Good thing we found it in time. It's just a little weak now, but if we'd been any later... who knows what might've happened.

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: G—Goodness... That's dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Hmph, can't blame anyone but yourself for crawling in there, silly cat.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: Well, it's not really the cat's fault. These Twinleaf Pitcher Plants give off a special scent. Humans aren't affected, but insects and other little creatures might get drawn in.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That's how the plants catch their prey. There's an unusual number of pitcher plants here, small animals are affected by their presence too.

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Oh... I see. Anyway, having this many of these plants grow here is definitely not a good sign, right?

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That's right. If we leave them alone, they could cause some real trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Alright, then we'll handle the weeding. Jukka, come help too!

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: These plants made our silly cat suffer so much. We have to return the favor.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With the help of the two treasure hunters, the unusual overgrowth of Twinleaf Pitcher Plants in the area is finally cleared...

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Phew... we're finally done. Time to head back to Nasha Town. Thanks a lot, miss, for helping us find this silly cat. If it weren't for your help, who knows how long it would've been trapped.

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, Marja, if you hadn't yelled so loudly earlier, we might have found it even sooner...

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Wh—What are you talking about? Anyway, the important thing is it's safe now.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Though she calls it "silly cat" all the time, she really does care about her companion, hehe.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: That's right. The important thing is it's safe. It's dangerous out here in the wilderness, so you guys have to be careful, too.

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: Thank you. We will.

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: And good luck with your investigation. Goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (There was nothing here not long ago, and now there are so many Twinleaf Pitcher Plants growing.)

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Maybe some animal brought the seeds here, but I can't just let them spread like this...)

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: You silly cat... where did you wander off to...?

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: Let's keep looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: It's not here...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: There's nothing there...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something nearby worth examining. <color=#FFCC33FF>Linnea</color>, with her deep knowledge of the local ecology, might find something useful...)

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Hey! You silly cat! Can you hear me!? If you can, come out right now!

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: If you don't, we're leaving without you!

dialogues.speaker: Jukka
dialogues.text: It's not here either...

dialogues.speaker: Faint Voice
dialogues.text: Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Linnea
dialogues.text: (Hmm? Looks like there's something over there...)

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: Silly cat!

dialogues.speaker: Marja
dialogues.text: You hear me!?
